## How it works

- [statement] The cited Prometheus Alertmanager documentation defines inhibition as suppressing notifications for certain alerts when specified other alerts are already firing. It describes silences as time-bounded muting: an incoming alert matching an active silence’s equality or regular-expression matchers receives no notification. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/alertmanager/ · keywords: Crypto bot monitor evidence and latency contracts

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The historical RFC 2679 explains that source/destination clock synchronization error and clock resolution contribute uncertainty to one-way IP delay measurements. It separately requires accounting for uncertainty between software host timestamps and wire times. (low confidence) — https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2679 · keywords: Crypto bot monitor evidence and latency contracts
- [statement] In the cited OAuth Bearer specification, invalid_token includes an expired, revoked, malformed or otherwise invalid access token; insufficient_scope means the request needs greater privileges than the token supplies. These error meanings belong to that authentication scheme. (low confidence) — https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750 · keywords: Crypto bot monitor evidence and latency contracts

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The cited OAuth Bearer specification says a resource server should omit an error code when a request lacks authentication information, including an unsupported authentication method. Its missing-authentication example differs from the invalid_token error response. (low confidence) — https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750 · keywords: Crypto bot monitor evidence and latency contracts

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The cited Grafana Cloud IRM response documentation says silencing prevents notifications for a specified duration without resolving the issue. While the group is silenced, IRM records source firing and resolve signals but does not act on them. This is notification-handling state, not evidence that the underlying bot has recovered. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-09) — https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/respond-to-incidents/respond-to-alerts/ · keywords: Crypto bot monitor evidence and latency contracts
